class LimitLine(instrument, data_handler, line_num)[source]¶

Bases: object

LimitLine commands for a specific limit line number (1-6).

__init__(instrument, data_handler, line_num)[source]¶
build()[source]¶

Build limit line points from trace, max holding across frequency sections.

clear()[source]¶

Resets the selected limit line. Removes all points stored.

clear_all_limit_lines()[source]¶

Resets all limit lines. Removes all points stored.

disable_display_result()[source]¶

When disabled, the limit line pass/fail result will not be visible on the graticule.

disable_pause()[source]¶

When enabled, a failure of this limit will pause the sweep update.

disable_testing(state)[source]¶

Disable testing of this limit line. If there are not at least 2 points in the limit line, testing doesn’t occur despite being enabled.

enable_display_result()[source]¶

When enabled, the limit line pass/fail result will be visible on the graticule.

enable_pause()[source]¶

When enabled, a failure of this limit will pause the sweep update.

enable_testing(state)[source]¶

Enable testing of this limit line. If there are not at least 2 points in the limit line, testing doesn’t occur despite being enabled.

get_build_points()[source]¶

Query the number of points used when building limit line from trace.

Returns:

Number of points used when building limit line from trace.

get_data()[source]¶

Returns the points in the limit line. Points are returned as freq/amplitude pairs where the frequencies are specified as Hz and the amplitudes as dBm.

Returns:

The points in the limit line as freq/ampl pairs.

get_interpolate()[source]¶

Query the interpolation type of the limit line.

Returns:

The interpolation type of the limit line.

get_offset_y()[source]¶

Query the dB offset of the limit line.

Returns:

The dB offset of the limit line.

get_points_count()[source]¶

Returns the number of points in the limit line as an integer.

Returns:

Number of points in the limit line.

get_reference()[source]¶

Query the reference type of the limit line.

Returns:

The reference type of the limit line.

get_title()[source]¶

Query the current name of the limit line.

Returns:

The current name of the limit line.

get_trace()[source]¶

Query the trace number tested against this limit line.

Returns:

The trace number tested against this limit line.

get_type()[source]¶

Query the type of the limit line (‘UPPER’ or ‘LOWER’).

Returns:

The type of the limit line (‘UPPER’ or ‘LOWER’).

is_display_line_enabled()[source]¶

Query if line display is enabled.

Returns:

True if line display is enabled, False otherwise.

is_display_result_enabled()[source]¶

Query if result display is enabled.

Returns:

True if result display is enabled, False otherwise.

is_enabled()[source]¶

Query if limit line testing is enabled.

Returns:

True if limit line testing is enabled, False otherwise.

is_failed()[source]¶

Returns 1 when the limit test has failed, 0 if passed.

Returns:

True if the limit test has failed, False otherwise.

is_pause_enabled()[source]¶

Query if pause on failure is enabled.

Returns:

True if pause on failure is enabled, False otherwise.

set_build_points(num_points)[source]¶

Specify how many points to use when building limit line from trace.

Parameters:

num_points – Number of points to use when building limit line from trace.

set_data(points)[source]¶

Specify the points in the limit line, will override any existing points. Points are specified as freq/amplitude pairs where the amplitude is specified as dBm.

Parameters:

points – List of (freq, ampl) pairs.

set_interpolate(interp)[source]¶

Specify whether the limit line uses linear or logarithmic interpolation.

Parameters:

interp – ‘LINEAR’ or ‘LOGARITHMIC’

set_offset_y(offset)[source]¶

Specify a dB offset to the limit line.

Parameters:

offset – dB offset to the limit line.

set_reference(ref)[source]¶

Specify whether the limit line values are fixed/absolute or relative to the center frequency and ref level.

Parameters:

ref – ‘FIXED’ or ‘RELATIVE’

set_title(title)[source]¶

Specify the name of the limit line.

Parameters:

title – The name of the limit line.

set_trace(trace_num)[source]¶

Specify which trace is tested against this limit line.

Parameters:

trace_num – The trace number to test against this limit line.

set_type(typ)[source]¶

Specify whether the limit line is tested as an upper bound or lower bound.

Parameters:

typ – ‘UPPER’ or ‘LOWER’

transform_reference()[source]¶

Convert the limit line reference type between fixed and relative by recalculating points based on the current configuration.

float

bool

True if marker is enabled, False otherwise.

bool

maximum()[source]¶

Perform a peak search.

maximum_left()[source]¶

Move the marker to the next peak to the left of its current position. Only peaks that meet the peak criteria are considered.

maximum_next()[source]¶

Move the marker to the next highest peak. Only peaks that meet the peak criteria are considered.

maximum_right()[source]¶

Move the marker to the next peak to the right of its current position (higher frequency). Only peaks that meet the peak criteria are considered.

minimum()[source]¶

Perform a minimum peak search.

select(marker_num)[source]¶

Select the active marker.

Parameters:

marker_num (int) – Marker index.

set_center()[source]¶

Set the sweep center frequency to the current marker frequency.

set_chpower_width(freq)[source]¶

Specify the width of the channel power marker measurement as a frequency.

Parameters:

freq (float) – Channel power marker width (Hz).

set_delta(state)[source]¶

When delta is enabled, the delta reference takes the current marker position and the marker measurement returns the delta frequency and amplitude between the current marker position and the delta reference.

Parameters:

state (int or str) – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable delta mode.

set_mode(mode)[source]¶

Switch between positional and noise marker.

Parameters:

mode (str) – ‘POSITION’, ‘NOISE’, ‘CHPOWER’, or ‘NDB’.

set_ndb_offset(value)[source]¶

Specify the offset of the N dB marker measurement in dB.

Parameters:

value (float) – N dB marker offset (dB).

set_peak_excursion(value)[source]¶

Specify the peak excursion in dB. How many dB above surrounding points the point must be before being considered a peak.

Parameters:

value (float) – Peak excursion in dB.

set_peak_threshold(value)[source]¶

Specify the peak threshold. A point must exceed this amount before being considered as a peak. Once the threshold test is met, then the excursion test is ran. If it meets both, then a point is considered a peak.

Parameters:

value (float) – Peak threshold in dBm.

set_peak_track(state)[source]¶

When enabled, the marker performs a peak search on each new trace update.

Parameters:

state (int or str) – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable peak tracking.

set_rlevel()[source]¶

Set the sweep reference level to the current marker amplitude.

set_state(state)[source]¶

Turn the marker on/off.

Parameters:

state (int or str) – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable marker.

set_trace(trace_num)[source]¶

Specify which trace to place the marker on. The trace must also be active to retrieve marker measurements.

Parameters:

trace_num (int) – Trace index to place marker on.

set_update(state)[source]¶

When update is disabled, the marker will hold its current position and will not update on future sweep updates.

Parameters:

state (int or str) – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable marker update.

set_x(freq)[source]¶

Move the marker position to the specified frequency.

Parameters:

freq (float) – Frequency to move marker to (Hz).

int

Query the frequency of the marker as a frequency offset from the carrier. If the reference marker is active, returns the difference between reference and current position.

The marker frequency offset from carrier (Hz).

Query the amplitude of the marker as dBc/Hz. If the reference marker is active, returns the dB difference between reference and current position.

The marker amplitude as dBc/Hz.

select(marker_num)[source]¶

Specify the active marker index. All future operations will occur on this marker.

Parameters:

marker_num (int) – Marker index [1-6].

set_delta(state)[source]¶

Enable or disable the delta marker. A reference marker is created when enabled. Updating delta again updates the reference marker.

Parameters:

state (int or str) – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable delta marker.

set_state(state)[source]¶

Enable or disable the marker.

Parameters:

state (int or str) – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable the marker.

set_trace(trace_num)[source]¶

Select which trace the marker is placed on. The marker is updated immediately.

Parameters:

trace_num (int) – Trace index [1-3].

set_x(freq)[source]¶

Set the marker frequency as an offset from the carrier frequency.

Parameters:

freq (float) – Marker frequency offset from carrier (Hz).
